column1: # Models that met the --smart qualification thresholds (SL-4).
# scripts/slm/qualify_model.sh <file.gguf> --record appends a line when a model
# meets all three, measured on the benchmark's train split against the
# rules-only path of the same compiler:
#   1. utility: the model path's mean utility is at least the rules-only
#      path's (model - rules >= 0, paired over every case);
#   2. false confidence: at most 20% of the fixes it shows are wrong;
#   3. determinism: the same input gives the same answer twice with the
# `--smart` prints one note when the model it loads is not listed here, and
# runs it anyway: the user chooses the model.
